comments.body:
Architecture review: mixed result. The expanded real-Git ordering/conflict/cleanup fixtures are valuable and should be retained, but `test_a_scope_the_planner_ranks_nothing_in_refuses_to_compose` **pins the known KOD-110 membership bug as desired behavior**. It closes every criterion while retaining all recorded deliverable refs, confirms `read_scope_ready(...).ready == ()`, then requires `DeliveryCoordinator.verify()` to refuse. That is exactly the counterexample where the union still must include the completed lanes' delivery heads.

When repairing KOD-110/F02, change this oracle rather than preserving it: completed participating lanes with retained delivery refs remain union members; dispatch readiness and union membership are distinct predicates. Keep the planner-order tests, but derive the complete union roster independently and apply planner/topology ordering to it. Canonical issue finding: KOD-110 comments `9db9ee7f-5b95-4725-bef5-6021b59d848e` and independent revalidation `3e6956cc-f53e-4de4-b1c9-127446a438a0`.
